sheets.cover_title: RECREATION -> LAUNDRY WALL · WALL PANELS, BACKING FRAMES, CLIPS, CONCEALED DOOR D01
questions: Door D01 must be flush with the wall panels. Our build-up: backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} (Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount) + panel {{bu['panel_t']}} = finished face {{bu['face']}} mm from the wall. Please confirm a jamb depth of {{dr('D01')['jamb']}} mm on a {{dr('D01')['wall_t']}} mm wall, and send the revised hinge / stop detail.

Opening per UCON survey is {{ow('D01')}} x {{oh('D01')}} mm (your drawing: 989 x 2451). Please build D01 to our opening with your technical gaps: head {{dr('D01')['gap_head']}}, sides {{dr('D01')['gap_side']}}, floor 0 -> frame {{ow('D01') - 2 * dr('D01')['gap_side']}} x {{oh('D01') - dr('D01')['gap_head']}}, leaf cladding {{op('D01')['clad'][1] - op('D01')['clad'][0]}} x {{op('D01')['clad'][3] - op('D01')['clad'][2]}}, {{op('D01')['clad'][2]}} mm to the finished floor. Please confirm.
Right-handed, opens into the Laundry, concealed hinges, soft-close. Please send the hinge make, model and specification.
Your section shows the leaf body and hinge block down to 0 mm at the floor; only the cladding has a 5 mm gap. What is the actual clearance of the leaf body? Is there a threshold or seal?
Door cladding thickness: the current profile shows 12 mm, an older table showed 25 mm. Please confirm 12 mm.

Panels hang on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, gap {{bu['clip_gap']}}. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs at the factory per the D-sheets (D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} deep). Please confirm which clip half goes into the panel (we assume male) and that you can drill per the schedule.
Wall height per UCON survey is {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}} mm (your drawing: 3052). Panel rows are laid out to {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}}.
Wine room glass door is installed; final measurement pending. Panel edges P14 / P16 at the opening and the bottom of P11 / P12 are TBD until then.

All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK: X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge. A control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Q7 was withdrawn in v1.1. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm, Z from the finished floor. Dimensions per UCON survey govern; from the TM drawings only the D01 door profile is used.

Wall panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM, joints 10; 10 to the floor, ceiling and wall corners, no baseboard. Panel face {{bu['face']}} from the wall = backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} + panel {{bu['panel_t']}}. Numbers P02..P16 as TM order 260318.

Backing frames S01..S{{format('%02d', @s['frames'].values.sum { |f| f['frames'].size })}}: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703); a frame member behind every panel joint - no raw wall in a joint. v1.2: the lower frames start {{@s['levels']['floor_gap']}} above the floor (were 25). Clips Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount, {{@s['holes'].size}} pcs: panel recesses D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW, unchanged from v1.1), frame holes D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['frame_depth']}} by UCON CNC.
Door D01: TM concealed door, flush with the panels (jamb {{dr('D01')['jamb']}}, Q1), built to our opening (Q2). Panels {{rebated}} rear {{bu['rebate']}} rebated at the D01 frame (A-701, D-sheets).
Wine room: glass door installed by others; P14 / P16 edges and the bottom of P11 / P12 TBD until it is measured (Q9).
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.
